faq.hero_title: The questions I had before buying, answered honestly

rolls.q: Does it roll up when walking or sitting?
rolls.a: No. That's exactly why Nuvel exists. The girdle has a silicone band on the inner top edge that anchors it to your skin and keeps it in place even when you sit, bend, climb stairs or dance at a wedding. We tested different patterns and band heights for months until we found the combination that works on real bodies, not mannequins.

size.q: How do I choose the right size?
size.a: We use a guide based on your waist and hip measurements, not your usual clothing size (which varies a lot by brand). On the product page you'll find the full chart in centimeters. If you're between two sizes, choose the larger one: Nuvel compresses without squeezing, so it never rides up.

visible.q: Does it show under dresses and tight pants?
visible.a: No. The edges are laser-cut, with no raised seam and no fabric step. They're so thin they disappear under silk, crepe or any fitted fabric. It was the first requirement of the pattern: that a woman could put on a fitted dress without having to check it doesn't show before heading out.

bathroom.q: Can I use the bathroom without taking it off?
bathroom.a: The girdle has an opening where it's needed, designed so you can use the bathroom without undressing and putting it back on. That said, we always recommend checking it's sitting right when you're done.

washing.q: How many times can I wash it?
washing.a: No limit. The fabric is designed to keep its structure and compression after many washes. We recommend hand washing or a delicate cycle at 30°C, no spin, and air drying. Following this, the girdle keeps its shape.

curvy.q: Does it work if I have love handles?
curvy.a: Yes. We use progressive compression: layered, from softer to firmer, instead of squeezing everything equally and creating the classic bulge at the back and hips. The result is a smooth finish, not a roll marked at the fabric's edge.

heat.q: Is it too warm? Does it breathe?
heat.a: The microfiber breathes and doesn't trap heat like girdles made from cheap synthetic fabrics. You can wear it in summer, even at 30°C at a wedding, without ending up drenched. That said, it's still a compression garment, not a dress.

itchy.q: Does it itch? Can I wear it all day?
itchy.a: The microfiber we use is certified and has no raised seams or stiff fabrics that chafe the skin. Designed for eight hours of continuous wear. The structure keeps its shape after dozens of washes.

return.q: What if I'm not convinced? Can I return it?
return.a: Yes. You have 30 days from receiving your order to return it, no explanation needed. Email us at hola@nuvelshape.store and we'll arrange a home pickup, at no cost to you. Buying underwear online requires trust, and that trust has to go both ways.

controller.text: Nuvel is an online store run from Venezuela that sells to customers in any country in the world. When the buyer resides in the European Union, we process their data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR, EU Regulation 2016/679), even though we are not established in the Union. For buyers from other countries, we apply these same data protection standards as a minimum.

about.hero_title: Shapers that show in the mirror, not through your clothes: why we made them
about.p1: Nuvel was born out of the same old frustration: the shaper that rolls up by mid-afternoon, the one that itches, the one that shows under your dress on exactly the day you need it most. Before selling a single garment, we tried the fast-fashion ones ourselves and wrote down everything that failed, so we wouldn't repeat it.
about.p2: We bought several, the cheap ones and the expensive ones, and wore them for entire days: to work, to dinner, to a wedding. We noted what time each one rolled up, where it showed, and how long it lasted before bothering us. With that list in hand, we looked for a manufacturer that could meet every point, and we didn't launch anything until a garment passed that same full-day test.
about.quote: We weren't looking for a miracle shaper. We were looking for one that did what it promised: doesn't roll up, doesn't show, and lasts a full day worn.
about.p3: That's where our product decisions come from: laser-cut edges so they don't show under clothes, progressive compression instead of squeezing everything equally, an inner band so it doesn't ride up, and a size chart in centimeters so you know exactly which one to order.
about.p4: Today we sell directly, with no store in between, and we answer every WhatsApp message ourselves. No magic promises: if a garment hadn't convinced us in person, we wouldn't launch it.
about.closing_line: The silhouette you want. Without anyone knowing.

product_faja.headline: You're wearing a shaper and nobody can tell
product_faja.details_text: The Nuvel Invisible Shaping Girdle shapes your waist without its edge ever showing. Seamless laser-cut edges, soft compression, and a high-waist cut you forget about the moment you sit down. It's the garment for wedding day, gala night, and the day you simply have to go to work in pants that don't forgive anything. Available from S to XL with a chart built for your body (waist and hip in centimeters), not the size on another brand's label.
product_faja.fear_1_text: It doesn't show. The edge is flat and seamless: no fabric step, no line showing under your dress. It's the first requirement of the pattern, not an extra.
product_faja.fear_2_text: If it rolls up when you sit down, we'll refund you. No questions asked. The silicone band on the inner edge anchors it to your skin so it stays where it belongs.
product_faja.fear_3_text: If it's not your size, return it for free within the 30-day trial. And if you're between two sizes, order the larger one: it compresses the same and won't ride up.
product_faja.testimonials_text: 4.8 out of 5 · 123 customers helped over WhatsApp. We're asking permission to publish their messages exactly as they are, unedited.
product_faja.faq_1_q: Does it show under a dress?
product_faja.faq_1_a: No. The edges are laser-cut, with no raised seam or fabric step: they lie flat on your skin and leave no line under silk, crepe or any fitted fabric. That's why it's called invisible.
product_faja.faq_2_q: Will it roll up when I sit down?
product_faja.faq_2_a: The silicone band on the inner edge keeps it anchored to your skin even when you sit, bend down or dance. And if it still rolls up on you, we'll refund you during the 30-day trial: it has to work in real life, not just in lab conditions.
product_faja.faq_3_q: Will it show love handles on my back or thighs?
product_faja.faq_3_a: The top edge is flat and seamless, so it doesn't dig into your skin. Compression is distributed and increases progressively toward the edge, which is what prevents that classic bulge line.
product_faja.faq_4_q: I'm between two sizes, which one should I order?
product_faja.faq_4_a: The larger one. Nuvel compresses without squeezing: the bigger size compresses just as well and, more importantly, won't ride up. The chart measures your waist and hip in centimeters, not another brand's size. And if you get it wrong, you have 30 days to return it, no questions asked.
product_faja.faq_5_q: Do I have to take it all off to use the bathroom?
product_faja.faq_5_a: It has a practical opening at the bottom so you can use the bathroom without having to take the garment off. If your model didn't have it, we'd tell you before you buy, not after.
product_faja.faq_6_q: Can I eat with it on?
product_faja.faq_6_a: Yes. The compression is medium, not an extreme-compression corset: you can take a deep breath and eat without it cutting off your digestion. It's designed for an entire Saturday, not two hours of suffering.
product_faja.faq_7_a: The fabric is thin and breathable, it's not latex or neoprene. It doesn't heat up like gym girdles: it compresses without making you sweat under a summer dress.
product_faja.faq_8_q: How long does it take to arrive?
product_faja.faq_8_a: 7 to 15 business days to mainland Spain, with email tracking. Balearic Islands, Canary Islands, Ceuta and Melilla: 12 to 25 days. We say this clearly so there are no surprises the week of the wedding.

product_corse.headline: YOU DECIDE HOW MUCH IT HOLDS
product_corse.details_text: The Nuvel Waist Shaping Corset combines vertical boning, a front zipper and a column of adjustable hooks on the back, so you control the compression level, not the garment. Ideal for defining your waistline under a blazer, a dress, or even worn as a top with high-waisted pants. One-piece back with no clasps to dig in, adjustable wide straps, and available in black, beige and pink, from XS to 2XL.
product_corse.feature_1_image_alt: The black Nuvel corset worn, waist defined
product_corse.feature_1_title: You decide how much it holds
product_corse.feature_1_text: The zipper is for getting in and out without fighting the garment. The hooks at the back are what really matter: they have three positions, so you start with the loosest and tighten as you get used to it. You don't have to suffer for it to show results.
product_corse.feature_2_image_alt: The Nuvel corset seen from the back, smooth back
product_corse.feature_2_text: The back is one piece with a single center seam, with no clasps or hooks to dig in or show. The straps are wide and flat, so they won't dig into your shoulder even if you wear it all day.
product_corse.feature_3_text: Black goes with everything and is the most ordered. Beige disappears under white, linen and any light fabric. And pink is the one you show off: worn with high-waisted pants, it works as a top, not as underwear.
product_corse.pairs_text: The corset shapes your waist and supports your torso. The girdle covers your abdomen and hips without showing anything under your clothes. Each does its own job, and together is when you see the full result.

product_vestido.feature_1_text: The usual routine is shaper plus dress: two purchases, two layers, and the shaper's edge showing exactly where you don't want it to. Here the shaping layer is sewn inside the dress. One garment, zero edges, and one purchase instead of two.
product_vestido.feature_2_image_alt: The Nuvel shaping dress in grey, seen from the back
product_vestido.feature_2_title: Black for night, grey for day
product_vestido.feature_2_text: Black is the everyday go-to: dinner, a wedding, anything. Grey is the one you can wear on a Tuesday with sneakers and a jacket over it without looking like you're dressed for a party. Same cut, same compression, different occasion.
product_vestido.headline: THE DRESS AND THE SHAPER, IN ONE GARMENT
product_vestido.details_text: The Nuvel 2-in-1 Shaping Dress has the compression layer sewn in on the inside, so you skip the separate shaper and the edge that shows through the fabric. Soft compression at abdomen, waist and hip, thin straps and a midi length that works for everyday wear as much as for a dinner or an event. One garment, zero extra layers. Available in black and grey, from S to 3XL.
